brief.zh: 下面五个命题，哪些在每一行都为真？逐一判断。
brief.en: Which of these five propositions are true on every row? Mark each one.

hint.zh: 拿不准时，展开真值表逐行检查。
hint.en: If you are unsure, expand the truth table and check its rows.

hint.zh: 只要有一行为假，就不是每一行都为真。
hint.en: One false row is enough to rule it out.

hint.zh: 「若下雨并且刮风，则地湿」：能不能下雨、刮风，地却不湿？
hint.en: “If it rains and it is windy, then the ground is wet”: can it rain and be windy while the ground stays dry?

t.zh: 「若 X，则 Y」写作 X → Y；「X 并且 Y」在 X、Y 都为真时才为真。
t.en: “If X, then Y” is written X → Y; “X and Y” is true only when both X and Y are.

t.zh: 在每一行都为真的命题叫<wiki-ref to="tautology"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: A proposition true on every row is a <wiki-ref to="tautology"></wiki-ref>.

after.zh: 一个命题是否永真，只取决于它的逻辑形式：把其中的基本命题换成别的，结论不变。
after.en: Whether a proposition is a tautology depends only on its logical form: put other propositions in place of its atoms and the verdict stays the same.
